name: noise-XX-abstract
description: Abstract, wire-INCOMPATIBLE teaching model loosely inspired by the Noise XX pattern (-> e, <- e ee s es, -> s se). Tokens are treated as opaque message types; no real Diffie-Hellman, key schedule, or AEAD is modeled. Do NOT use for interoperability or security claims.

transitions.note: Message 1: initiator ephemeral. Requires a fresh nonce.
Message 2: responder ephemeral + mixed tokens (abstract), sequenced.
